Hailing from Oakland, CA, Phantasmal Abyss continues the legacy of the three-piece; albeit in a more extreme, and genre defying fashion. Made up by Dara Santhai (Serpent Crown, Larvae), Todd Wilkinson (drums) and Rafael Martinez (Black Cobra/Acid King/16), Phantasmal Abyss has been churning out unorthodox extreme metal since 2021. Steeped in thick riffs, twisting melodies and organic tones that bring Bay Area stalwarts Neurosis to mind, PA adds a bit of dare we say it "musicality" to their extreme metal arrangements. Part blackened, part thrash, and part death, PA offers a fresh and interesting take on an often-overpopulated genre of bands trying to "out-heavy each other". Think Aura Noir meets Morbid Angel with the more DIY attitude of Oakland's crust scene.

Since their inception, Phantasmal Abyss has methodically carved their way across the west coast and south west, sharing the stage with Belphegor, Wayfarer,  Bewitcher, Perpetual Warfare (Colombia), Arkona,  Insanity and Solicitor.
 
Spring 2025 saw Phantasmal Abyss storm into Earhammer Studios with Grammy-winning engineer Greg Wilkinson to record the follow up to 2023’s The Spawn of Lycaon.  7 Songs are audial poison are to be unleashed. 

WINTER WIND
A heavy 3 piece from Santa Cruz/ Salinas established in 2015 for fans of Budgie, UFO, Devil's Blood, Witchfinder

EL SOL
El Sol is a 10-piece band devoted to Salsa music – especially Salsa Dura NY-style. We play original arrangements of classic 70's songs from Eddie Palmieri, Ray Barretto, and Willie Colon as well as Latin standards. Our two singers, two trombones, flute, bongo, conga, timbale, keyboards and bass create an infectious groove that will bring you to the dance floor.
